# Public PDF fixtures

No third-party PDF is committed to this repository.

The optional real-world smoke fixture is Adrian Chapman and Steven T.
Flammia, *Characterization of solvable spin models via graph invariants*,
arXiv:2003.05465v2. The paper is marked CC BY 4.0 on its arXiv record. Margin
downloads the versioned PDF directly from arXiv into the ignored local cache
and verifies the SHA-256 digest recorded in `public-pdfs.json`.

The short formula and diagram strings in unit tests are minimal geometry
fixtures rather than reproduced PDF pages. The synthetic
`public/demo-paper.pdf` is generated by this project and covered by the
repository license.
